data.one_liner: Unicode and grapheme cluster aware string manipulation operations for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Characters class and CharacterRange iterator to safely manipulate strings at the human-perceived character level. It avoids issues with splitting combined characters, surrogate pairs, or emojis that occur with standard code-unit based String operations.
use_when: You need to truncate or abbreviate text containing emojis or complex Unicode characters.
You are processing user-entered text where grapheme cluster boundaries matter.
avoid_when: You need to use regular expressions, as they are not grapheme cluster aware.
You require index-based string access, which is not supported due to variable grapheme cluster lengths.
strengths: Safe handling of emojis and combined characters.
Bi-directional navigation and range manipulation via CharacterRange.
weaknesses: Operations cannot be index-based because grapheme clusters have varying lengths.
Regular expressions cannot be used safely directly on a sequence of characters.
